description: This source file contains extension methods for configuring and using Orleans clients within different host builder contexts in the .NET environment. It provides methods to integrate Orleans clients into HostBuilder, HostApplicationBuilder, and IServiceCollection, including handling multiple configuration calls, and ensures that only one Orleans client is configured per host instance.

classes.name: OrleansBuilderMarker
classes.description: A marker class used to store an Orleans client builder instance within a service collection for identification and retrieval.

methods.name: UseOrleansClient
methods.description: Configures the host or host application builder to include and initialize an Orleans client, with or without a custom configuration delegate.

methods.name: AddOrleansClient
methods.description: Adds and configures an Orleans client builder to the service collection, preventing multiple initializations, and supporting custom configuration via delegate.
